request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Create ONE edge-to-edge landscape PNG at exactly 1536×1024. Location-key recipe establish: full environment detail, visible named key light, readable real scale. No collage, borders, text or action scene.

L9 mangwon_market/key.png. A full detailed reference view DOWN THE COVERED MARKET STREET at evening, camera at 1.6 m on the tiled/concrete ground, one clear common horizon in the distance. The main street is 6 m wide and the high arcade roof about 7 m above it (current chapter 11 scale); stalls sit to both sides, leaving a readable central walking route. Translucent roof panels and attached slim steel ribs rise naturally toward the top edge; crop the nearest roof if it is too high to fit, rather than lowering it to adult head height. Little openings between shops lead to narrow 1.5–2 m side alleys. At picture-left, produce stalls with cabbages, long radishes, green onions and fruit in shallow crates; farther left, silver fish on an ice tray. At picture-right, pale rice cakes in neat trays beside closed plastic tubs and round red kimchi basins; no price tags or wrappers with print. Stall counters about waist height, 0.9 m, plain attached awning frames, hanging warm-white bulbs on visible wires over the counters. Key light is these HANGING MARKET BULBS, on and warm against cool slate-blue evening filtering through the translucent roof; small source washes only, no all-over yellow fog. Exactly TWO TINY GENERIC ADULT scale figures at different depths on the central ground plane, one holding a shopping bag at the side and pausing near a stall, the other farther away mid-step. Adults about 1.7–1.78 m, normal 7.5–8 heads with long legs and small heads; keep them small in the environment without shrinking them relative to waist-high counters. Heads sit near the common eye-level horizon; farther person smaller, feet higher in the picture. Do not copy Jaeha: his attached front sheet is only an approved adult scale/ink comparison. No orange vest, T patch, pencil, notebook, named face or other named cast. Stall goods, tubs and shop structures are the focus, not a crowd. The place is tidy and calm before any story action. Every hand holds its bag or strap, no floating limbs. Crisp drawn surfaces with large opaque cel-value planes and restrained local detail.The general Mangwon Market design is a long covered traditional market street with a high translucent pale blue-grey arcade roof on slim steel ribs, narrow side alleys branching between the shops, stalls of vegetables, fish, tteok rice cakes and kimchi, hanging bulbs, red/blue plastic tubs and modest concrete/shop fronts. Evening, market lights on. Any signboard is a plain empty panel with no letters, glyphs or prices. No gate, monsters, emergency effects, debris or chapter action: these are calm location references.

Use the attached approved Arc 1 images as the house rendering/material and adult-proportion references, never layouts or named characters to copy. The final attachment is an approved acting-style anchor: match its crisp tapered ink, clean opaque shadow shapes and restrained source-light wash. Draw only the new scene named here. No L6/L7 or other unapproved generated entry is an input.



No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

review_notes: Near shopper is a large foreground figure rather than a tiny scale figure; additional distant people appear near the vanishing point. Location brief allows one or two tiny scale people only.
